title: The same food gets the same estimate across days
seen: The same no-milk boba: 225 kcal on 29 Oct, 90 kcal on 1 Nov, each with its own confident sum and no word about the other.

earlier_rows: Boba tea no milk no sugar + honey tapioca

turns: Had a boba black tea, no sugar, no milk. The tapioca was sweet though
facts: Three days ago the ledger logged the same drink (boba tea, no milk, no sugar, honey tapioca) at 225 kcal and 1 g protein. That row is in the ledger file.

criteria.text: The tool calls show a files.append writing a row for the boba tea to food/food-log.csv.
The row's kcal is between 170 and 280 (the earlier 225, give or take a quarter), OR the reply says plainly that this differs from the earlier 225 kcal and says which figure it kept and why.
The reply states the figure as an estimate or as reused from the earlier row.
